messages.content: Translate each English source unit into accurate, complete Modern Standard Arabic. Preserve meaning, names, scripture references, and unit order. Do not add explanations or content. Output JSON only: {"book_code":"JASHER","verses":[{"chapter":1,"verse":1,"source_ref":"1:1","text_ar":"..."}]}. Return exactly one row for each input source_ref.

{"book_code":"JASHER","units":[{"text":"And a wind passed over the earth, and the waters were still and the ark rested.","source_ref":"6:33","verse":33,"chapter":6},{"text":"And the fountains of the deep and the windows of heaven were stopped, and the rain from heaven was restrained.","source_ref":"6:34","verse":34,"chapter":6},{"text":"And the waters decreased in those days, and the ark rested upon the mountains of Ararat.","source_ref":"6:35","verse":35,"chapter":6},{"text":"And Noah then opened the windows of the ark, and Noah still called out to the Lord at that time and he said, O Lord, who didst form the earth and the heavens and all that are therein, bring forth our souls from this confinement, and from the prison wherein thou hast placed us, for I am much wearied with sighing.","source_ref":"6:36","verse":36,"chapter":6},{"text":"And the Lord hearkened to the voice of Noah, and said to him, When though shalt have completed a full year thou shalt then go forth.","source_ref":"6:37","verse":37,"chapter":6}]}
